fields.description: Issue includes prominent local political coverage focused on a proposed recall of Miami’s mayor and discussion of Miami municipal election candidates and slates. Reports and commentary address alleged abuses involving Henry L. Doherty and the Miami-Biltmore/Coral Gables authorities, including an assault complaint and references to NRA wage-hour standards. The paper also highlights a campaign against illegal small-loan practices, citing positions of major employers regarding salary assignments, and prints excerpts/parody-style material from Florida Senate proceedings. Regular columns cover local social items, sports (boxing), entertainment/nightlife, and extensive local advertising.
